say:0:1120801001:0.text: Lord Pike's bounty job will be mine!
say:0:1120801001:0.source_cn: 荒矛老爷的悬赏，最后一定是我拿下！

say:1:1120801002:0.text: Get lost! That job is mine!
say:1:1120801002:0.source_cn: 都滚开，荒矛的赏金等着我！

say:2:1120801003:0.text: What's got Alkali so riled up?
say:2:1120801003:0.source_cn: 呜哇，咸水镇怎么变得吵吵闹闹的？

say:3:1120801004:0.text: They're all talking about this "Lord Pike" and his bounty job.
say:3:1120801004:0.source_cn: 他们都在谈论一个名字，“荒矛”……还有他的悬赏。
say:3:1120801004:0.male: They're all talking about this "Lord Pike" and his bounty job.
say:3:1120801004:0.female: They're all talking about this "Lord Pike" and his bounty job.

say:4:1120801005:0.text: The treasure hunt in the Crimson Highlands just ended, and now there's another bounty. Seems suspicious...
say:4:1120801005:0.source_cn: 深红高原的宝藏刚告一段落，突然又有高价悬赏，有些可疑。...
say:4:1120801005:0.male: The treasure hunt in the Crimson Highlands just ended, and now there's another bounty. Seems suspicious...
say:4:1120801005:0.female: The treasure hunt in the Crimson Highlands just ended, and now there's another bounty. Seems suspicious...

say:0:1120802001:0.text: These bounty hunters are going crazy.
say:0:1120802001:0.source_cn: 最近的赏金猎人都疯啦？

say:1:1120802002:0.text: All this racket over Pike's bounty...
say:1:1120802002:0.source_cn: 还不都是为了荒矛老爷的悬赏……

say:0:1120803001:0.text: I need some new weapons for this.
say:0:1120803001:0.source_cn: 得换把火器才能竞争过别人

say:1:1120803002:0.text: How many have their eyes on that bounty?
say:1:1120803002:0.source_cn: 还有多少人盯上了赏金？

say:2:1120804001:1.text: The bounty job's mine! You all might as well go home now!
say:2:1120804001:1.source_cn: 嘿，是老子我先接到的悬赏，你来凑什么热闹？

say:3:1120804002:1.text: That bounty's more than a one-man job. Why don't we partner up?
say:3:1120804002:1.source_cn: 那悬赏难度高得离谱，你自己一个人能搞定？不如咱们搭伙。

say:4:1120804003:1.text: You have to go to the <style="highlight">Crimson Highlands</style> to do the job, and you know what that place is like! You're putting your life on the line for gold!
say:4:1120804003:1.source_cn: 要拿到委托物必须得去<style=highlight>...

say:5:1120804004:1.text: I witnessed it myself a few days ago. Jerrick and Silver Bullet set out with a fire in their eyes, but they came back in coffins.
say:5:1120804004:1.source_cn: 我亲眼瞧见杰瑞克和银弹那几个家伙几天前雄心满志地出发了...

say:7:1120804006:1.text: I can't give up on that <style="highlight">bounty reward</style>. That's a huge pile of gold! If I could get my hands on that money, I never have to do another dangerous job again!
say:7:1120804006:1.source_cn: 但是我绝不会放弃<style=highlight>悬赏...

say:3:1120805001:1.text: Chippy has a question! Who exactly is this "Lord Pike" everyone's talking about?
say:3:1120805001:1.source_cn: 商人先生，打听一下！大家最近在谈论的荒矛老爷到底是谁？

say:4:1120805002:1.text: Oh, you folks doing the bounty thing too? Need some supplies for the road? I've got cloaks, grappling hooks, jerky, and everything else you might require!
say:4:1120805002:1.source_cn: 哦……你们几个也想去悬赏的热闹？要不要买些路上的防身物...

say:5:1120805003:1.text: Thanks, but we just want to know about this Pike person.
say:5:1120805003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你的好意，但我们只想知道荒矛老爷的事。

say:6:1120805004:1.text: I'm a simple merchant. I couldn't say much about a noble figure like a lord!
say:6:1120805004:1.source_cn: 老爷的事我也不知道，我只是个商人，还没有被称为“老爷”...

say:7:1120805005:1.text: What I can say, though, is that those bounty hunters have been swarming here like flies to a slaughter.
say:7:1120805005:1.source_cn: 不过，那些赏金猎人们倒像是盯上了刚宰的牛肉，像苍蝇一样...

say:8:1120805006:1.text: That reward must be something special. Otherwise, the hunters wouldn't have been dropping so much coin to buy gear from us.
say:8:1120805006:1.source_cn: 完成悬赏的报酬一定不菲。不然赏金猎人也不会投那么多本金...

say:9:1120805007:1.text: And another thing. People say this <style="highlight">Lord Pike has never shown his face</style>, and anyone who tried to find out who he is has disappeared...
say:9:1120805007:1.source_cn: 另外，我听到一个传闻：据说，<style=highli...

say:10:1120805008:1.text: That's all I know. And if you'd like to share a few coppers for my information, I'd appreciate it!
say:10:1120805008:1.source_cn: ——那么，作为情报费，请付铜币三枚，谢谢惠顾！

say:0:1120806001:0.text: Did Lord Pike really put up that much money...?
say:0:1120806001:0.source_cn: 那个荒矛老爷，真的拿出那么多钱？我也想见识见识……

say:1:1120806002:0.text: His butler is recruiting people at the <style="highlight">market entrance</style>. If you're so interested, why don't you go see for yourself?
say:1:1120806002:0.source_cn: 他的执事就在<style=highlight>集市入口...

say:2:1120806003:0.text: I-I ain't tough enough... or brave enough, for that matter!
say:2:1120806003:0.source_cn: 我、我这不是既没本事，胆子也不够大嘛！

say:2:1120807001:1.text: After asking around, all we know is that Lord Pike is a big spender and nobody's ever seen his face. And apparently, anyone who's tried to find out his identity has disappeared...
say:2:1120807001:1.source_cn: 打听了一圈，只知道荒矛老爷出手阔绰、没人见过他的真面目...

say:3:1120807002:1.text: Sounds shady to me! Didn't everyone get lied to about the treasure in the Crimson Highlands? Did no one learn their lesson? There's no such thing as a free lunch!
say:3:1120807002:1.source_cn: 听起来真是可疑呢！深红高原宝藏的谎言还没让大家醒悟过来...

say:4:1120807003:1.text: Chippy heard that Lord Pike's butler is somewhere near the <style="highlight">market</style>.
say:4:1120807003:1.source_cn: 满满听镇民说，那个荒矛的执事在<style=highl...

say:5:1120807004:1.text: Magister, do you want to go and have a look?
say:5:1120807004:1.source_cn: 主人，我们要不要直接过去看看？
say:5:1120807004:1.male: Magister, do you want to go and have a look?
say:5:1120807004:1.female: Magister, do you want to go and have a look?

choice_prompt:6:1120807004.text: Magister, do you want to go and have a look?
choice_prompt:6:1120807004.source_cn: 主人，我们要不要直接过去看看？
choice_prompt:6:1120807004.male: Magister, do you want to go and have a look?
choice_prompt:6:1120807004.female: Magister, do you want to go and have a look?

say:7:1120807005:1.text: Alright, but we have to be careful.
say:7:1120807005:1.source_cn: 那，我们一定要小心一点！

say:8:1120807006:1.text: Let's go, Chippy. We've got to figure out what this Lord Pike is up to.
say:8:1120807006:1.source_cn: 满满，咱们走，去看看那个荒矛老爷到底在谋划什么。

choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 确实从其他人嘴里打听不出情报

choice:6:1:2.text: Maybe we can take the job ourselves.
choice:6:1:2.source_cn: 顺便接下委托，赚点零花钱！
choice:6:1:2.male: Maybe we can take the job ourselves.
choice:6:1:2.female: Maybe we can take the job ourselves.

say:0:1120808001:0.text: Can I see the reward first?

say:3:1120809001:1.text: You! What are you doing here?!

say:4:1120809002:1.text: Are you up to no good again?
say:4:1120809002:1.source_cn: 你又在盘算什么坏主意呢？

say:5:1120809003:1.text: Come on... Let's let bygones be bygones, my beautiful furballs! My blowgun barely grazed you that time. You woke up quick, didn't you?
say:5:1120809003:1.source_cn: 哎呀……忘了之前的不愉快吧，仓鼠老弟。我那麻痹毒液的吹...

say:6:1120809004:1.text: And that fox girl got her necklace back, right?
say:6:1120809004:1.source_cn: 狐狸妹子也拿回了项链，而且完好无损，对不？

say:7:1120809005:1.text: Look, I just happened to find that pretty little thing on the ground, and thanks to you kind-hearted folks, it found its way back to its rightful owner. No harm done.
say:7:1120809005:1.source_cn: 我只是路上偶然捡到那么漂亮的东西，拿来欣赏欣赏，没别的...

choice_prompt:8:1120809005.text: Look, I just happened to find that pretty little thing on the ground, and thanks to you kind-hearted folks, it found its way back to its rightful owner. No harm done.
choice_prompt:8:1120809005.source_cn: 我只是路上偶然捡到那么漂亮的东西，拿来欣赏欣赏，没别的意思——还都要多亏正义的老爷小姐们，才能准确找到失主啊！

say:9:1120809006:1.text: What? No, I'm speaking from the heart here! It's true!
say:9:1120809006:1.source_cn: 不不，我说的每句话都发自肺腑、真心诚意！

say:10:1120809008:1.text: Look, this news about Lord Pike is sweeping across the desert like a sandstorm. It's all over town. I just came to see what's going on!
say:10:1120809008:1.source_cn: 瞧，这荒矛老爷的消息稀奇得和沙漠里的暴雨似的，在镇上传...

say:11:1120809009:1.text: The bounty reward sounds nice, but I'm not sure if it's for real...
say:11:1120809009:1.source_cn: 悬赏给的东西听起来可真不错，就是不知道是真是假……

choice_prompt:12:1120809009.text: The bounty reward sounds nice, but I'm not sure if it's for real...
choice_prompt:12:1120809009.source_cn: 悬赏给的东西听起来可真不错，就是不知道是真是假……

say:13:1120809010:1.text: I'm still asking around too. If you're interested, why don't we have a chat with his butler? I mean it couldn't hurt, right?
say:13:1120809010:1.source_cn: 这不，还在打听呢。你们要是也有兴趣，咱一起找老爷的执事...

choice:12:1:2.text: Do you know who Lord Pike is?
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 你知道荒矛老爷是谁吗？
choice:12:1:2.male: Do you know who Lord Pike is?
choice:12:1:2.female: Do you know who Lord Pike is?

say:15:1120809007:1.text: What? No, I'm speaking from the heart here! It's true!
say:15:1120809007:1.source_cn: 不不，我说的每句话都发自肺腑、真心诚意！

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 你不是偶然出现在这里

say:3:1120812001:1.text: Alright, my furry friends... and my non-furry friend... Are we working together or what?
say:3:1120812001:1.source_cn: 老爷小姐们，怎么样，要不要一起合作？

say:4:1120812002:1.text: If the reward is really the Dusk Eye, that rock is worth a heck of a price.
say:4:1120812002:1.source_cn: 赏金真给残阳之眼的话，那可金贵得很，能值一大笔钱。

say:5:1120812003:1.text: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
say:5:1120812003:1.source_cn: ……真是见钱眼开的人，立刻见风使舵来找主人帮忙了！
say:5:1120812003:1.male: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
say:5:1120812003:1.female: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.

choice_prompt:6:1120812003.text: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
choice_prompt:6:1120812003.source_cn: ……真是见钱眼开的人，立刻见风使舵来找主人帮忙了！
choice_prompt:6:1120812003.male: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.
choice_prompt:6:1120812003.female: It's just like you to come running to the our magister for help once money is in the picture.

say:7:1120812004:1.text: Here's the deal. I know a thing or two about the Dusk Eye. That gem is worth a ton of gold.
say:7:1120812004:1.source_cn: 别这么说。残阳之眼嘛，我多少知道一些，那种宝石很能卖得...

say:8:1120812005:1.text: Now, the only problem is that spider venom. Those spiders are extremely dangerous, and the Crimson Highlands are as well. Not a soul would go there if not for news of treasure.
say:8:1120812005:1.source_cn: 悬赏要的蜘蛛毒液才是个大麻烦，诡蛛毒性太大。而且深红高...

say:9:1120812006:1.text: But on the contrary, my perky ears have heard rumors that some adventurers have actually come back alive!
say:9:1120812006:1.source_cn: 不过，我这双耳朵听说，有些英勇无畏的老爷小姐们不但进了...

say:10:1120812007:1.text: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
say:10:1120812007:1.source_cn: 怎么样，要不要一起？和我合作那可是……嗯……总之，绝不...
say:10:1120812007:1.male: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
say:10:1120812007:1.female: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!

choice_prompt:11:1120812007.text: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
choice_prompt:11:1120812007.source_cn: 怎么样，要不要一起？和我合作那可是……嗯……总之，绝不会亏待<male>老爷</male><female>小姐</female>您！
choice_prompt:11:1120812007.male: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!
choice_prompt:11:1120812007.female: Come on, let's work together. Working with me is so... Well... I would never mistreat you, Magister!

say:12:1120812008:1.text: I knew the magister here was a smart one! I'm about to shed a tear!
say:12:1120812008:1.male: I knew the magister here was a smart one! I'm about to shed a tear!
say:12:1120812008:1.female: I knew the magister here was a smart one! I'm about to shed a tear!

say:13:1120812009:1.source_cn: 主、主人，就这么答应他了吗……

say:14:1120812010:1.text: I know you have your doubts, my furry friend. To show my sincerity in this endeavor, I'll handle the retrieval of the venom.
say:14:1120812010:1.source_cn: 我理解、我理解。仓鼠老弟，为了打消你们的疑虑，拿出合作...

choice_prompt:15:1120812010.text: I know you have your doubts, my furry friend. To show my sincerity in this endeavor, I'll handle the retrieval of the venom.
choice_prompt:15:1120812010.source_cn: 我理解、我理解。仓鼠老弟，为了打消你们的疑虑，拿出合作的诚意，这次悬赏要找的东西就包在我身上吧。

say:16:1120812011:1.text: Look, Magister, we all know you're a man of great ability. What if something else happens?
say:16:1120812011:1.male: Look, Magister, we all know you're a man of great ability. What if something else happens?
say:16:1120812011:1.female: Look, Magister, we all know you're a woman of great ability. What if something else happens?

say:17:1120812012:1.text: Come a little closer, I've got an idea.
say:17:1120812012:1.source_cn: 你们过来，离那位执事老爷远点！我有个主意。

choice:15:0:1.text: Didn't you say it was dangerous?
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 你刚刚还说找蜘蛛毒液麻烦？
choice:15:0:1.male: Didn't you say it was dangerous?
choice:15:0:1.female: Didn't you say it was dangerous?

choice:15:1:2.text: Then what do you need me for?
choice:15:1:2.male: Then what do you need me for?
choice:15:1:2.female: Then what do you need me for?

say:19:1120812013:1.text: You still don't trust me, Magister?
say:19:1120812013:1.male: You still don't trust me, Magister?
say:19:1120812013:1.female: You still don't trust me, Magister?

say:20:1120812014:1.text: Don't forget what you did before, when you took Satrana's necklace. And instead of giving it back, you shot an arrow at Chippy!
say:20:1120812014:1.source_cn: 别忘了你之前做过什么，拿了萨忒娜的项链不还，还给了满满一箭！

say:21:1120812015:1.text: Theft, assault, and running away! You've done it all!
say:21:1120812015:1.source_cn: 盗窃、伤人、逃逸，可以说什么坏事都做啦！

say:22:1120812016:1.text: Hey, that's only because I've fallen on hard times!
say:22:1120812016:1.source_cn: 哎呀，那是因为我很穷啊，老爷小姐们。

say:23:1120812017:1.text: Here in Alkali, if you try to set up a merchant stall, you've got folks coming and skimming off your earnings! Stall fees, security fees, water fees... Look at this place! They have water fees here!
say:23:1120812017:1.source_cn: 咸水镇这地方，摆个摊子要被好几拨人来来回回收好几次钱，...

say:24:1120812018:1.text: That's not an excuse to do bad things!
say:24:1120812018:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，那不是你做坏事的理由！

say:25:1120812019:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to get moving if we want a chance at this bounty. It'll take quite a while to get to the Crimson Highlands and back.
say:25:1120812019:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to get moving if we want a chance at this bounty. It'll take quite a while to get to the Crimson Highlands and back.
say:25:1120812019:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we need to get moving if we want a chance at this bounty. It'll take quite a while to get to the Crimson Highlands and back.

say:27:1120812021:1.text: Sheesh, what a shame... I'll have to figure it out myself then.
say:27:1120812021:1.source_cn: 唉……可惜呀。那就只能我自己想办法了。

choice:11:1:2.text: I don't know if we can work together.
choice:11:1:2.male: I don't know if we can work together.
choice:11:1:2.female: I don't know if we can work together.

choice:6:0:1.text: Know anything about the Dusk Eye?
choice:6:0:1.male: Know anything about the Dusk Eye?
choice:6:0:1.female: Know anything about the Dusk Eye?

choice:6:1:2.text: Why should we work with you?
choice:6:1:2.male: Why should we work with you?
choice:6:1:2.female: Why should we work with you?

choice:6:2:3.text: Don't try and lie to me...
choice:6:2:3.source_cn: 你在我这里没有信誉度
choice:6:2:3.male: Don't try and lie to me...
choice:6:2:3.female: Don't try and lie to me...

say:0:1120813001:0.text: C'mon! Closer, so no one can overhear!
say:0:1120813001:0.source_cn: 来，来，这边！别让执事老爷听见！

say:3:1120815001:1.text: Odie, what do you need to tell us that the butler can't hear?
say:3:1120815001:1.source_cn: 阿德，你特意避开执事先生，是想告诉我们什么？

say:4:1120815002:1.text: The butler wants venom from a Dark-Eyed Spider, right? Well, I don't think we even need to go to the Crimson Highlands.
say:4:1120815002:1.source_cn: 那位执事老爷不是要邪目蛛的毒液嘛，要我说，咱其实用不着...

choice_prompt:5:1120815002.text: The butler wants venom from a Dark-Eyed Spider, right? Well, I don't think we even need to go to the Crimson Highlands.
choice_prompt:5:1120815002.source_cn: 那位执事老爷不是要邪目蛛的毒液嘛，要我说，咱其实用不着真的往深红高原跑一趟。

say:6:1120815003:1.text: Spider venom is a tricky thing. I think something else will do just as well.
say:6:1120815003:1.source_cn: 诶呀，蜘蛛的毒不好搞，替代品还不是手到擒来嘛。

say:7:1120815004:1.text: You see, the snake venom that paralyzed our furry friend earlier is in high supply here. We just need to get my little pet snake to spit some out!
say:7:1120815004:1.source_cn: 之前让仓鼠老弟麻痹的蛇毒这里可有的是。只要让我养的这些...

say:8:1120815005:1.text: It's a perfect plan, right? I don't think the butler will know the difference...
say:8:1120815005:1.source_cn: 这不正好？估计那位执事老爷也分不出是这种毒还是那种毒……

choice_prompt:9:1120815005.text: It's a perfect plan, right? I don't think the butler will know the difference...
choice_prompt:9:1120815005.source_cn: 这不正好？估计那位执事老爷也分不出是这种毒还是那种毒……

say:10:1120815006:1.text: There's no harm, Magister. Spider venom paralyzes people, and so does my snake venom! And this way, I'm saving you a trip to the Crimson Highlands!
say:10:1120815006:1.male: There's no harm, Magister. Spider venom paralyzes people, and so does my snake venom! And this way, I'm saving you a trip to the Crimson Highlands!
say:10:1120815006:1.female: There's no harm, Magister. Spider venom paralyzes people, and so does my snake venom! And this way, I'm saving you a trip to the Crimson Highlands!

say:11:1120815007:1.text: Besides, there's no need to prove how brave and powerful you are, Magister. Of course, you'd make it to the Crimson Highlands and back without issue! It would be beneath you to go! I won't have them doubting your abilities!

say:1:1120830002:0.text: Let's head back and see what else Lord Pike wants.

say:3:1120831001:1.text: You have returned with what you claim is a neutralizer. I shall first test it.
say:3:1120831001:1.source_cn: 看来几位已经找到了中和剂，那么，请允许我验药。

say:4:1120831002:1.text: Congratulations, the neutralizer passed the test.
say:4:1120831002:1.source_cn: 恭喜各位，药效很好，检验无误。

say:5:1120831003:1.text: There were three trials, right? What's the last one?
say:5:1120831003:1.source_cn: 之前说有三项考验，那么，第三项是什么？

say:8:1120831004:1.text: I shall announce the third trial.
say:8:1120831004:1.source_cn: 第三道考验，就由我来公布吧。

choice_prompt:9:1120831004.text: I shall announce the third trial.
choice_prompt:9:1120831004.source_cn: 第三道考验，就由我来公布吧。

say:10:1120831005:1.text: No other bounty hunters were able to complete the second trial before you, so there was no need to reveal myself.
say:10:1120831005:1.source_cn: 在你们之前，没有赏金猎人能够完成第二道考验。所以我没有...

say:11:1120831007:1.text: The final trial is the most perilous. There is an old mine in the Crimson Highlands. There's treasure there, and I need someone to retrieve it for me.

say:13:1120831009:1.text: I get it! The first two trials were just tests to make sure we're strong enough to bring something back from that mine!
say:13:1120831009:1.source_cn: 这样啊……所以前两道考验，是老爷再测试我们有没有从矿洞...

say:14:1120831010:1.text: Precisely. Those unable to complete the first two trials would only lose their lives in the third.
say:14:1120831010:1.source_cn: 当然，无法完成前两项要求的人，去了也只能白白送命。

say:15:1120831011:1.text: And to demonstrate my sincerity, I won't let you face this risk alone. On this final operation, I will accompany you myself.

choice_prompt:16:1120831011.text: And to demonstrate my sincerity, I won't let you face this risk alone. On this final operation, I will accompany you myself.
choice_prompt:16:1120831011.source_cn: 为了以示诚意，我不会只让你们面对生命危险……这次最后的行动，我与你们同去。

say:17:1120831012:1.text: Think what you will, but as long as we return with the treasure, the Dusk Eye is yours.
say:17:1120831012:1.source_cn: 随你们怎么想。只要能取回珍宝，我不吝钱财，残阳之眼也必...

say:18:1120831013:1.text: I'll be there to guide you, with any tools you may need.

choice:9:1:2.text: We're finally able to lay eyes on you.

choice:9:1:2.female: We're finally able to lay eyes on you.

choice:9:2:3.text: What are these bounties all about?
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 你的悬赏究竟是为了什么？
choice:9:2:3.male: What are these bounties all about?
choice:9:2:3.female: What are these bounties all about?

say:0:1120832001:0.text: Here it is... the deepest and most treacherous mine in the Crimson Highlands...
say:0:1120832001:0.source_cn: 就是这里，深红高原最险峻深邃的矿洞……

say:1:1120832002:0.text: If we run into any beasts, I'll need your help. May fortune favor us.
say:1:1120832002:0.source_cn: 如果路上有妨碍的野兽，就麻烦几位了。祝各位好运。

say:3:1120833001:1.text: Ah! This cave is packed with poisonous spiders! We'd never make it without that neutralizer.

say:5:1120833003:1.text: See! Why did you want to come with us?! This is the last of our neutralizer. We got no more after this!

say:8:1120833004:1.text: We're out already? But we picked so much...

say:9:1120833005:1.text: Of course, we're out! After all, Lord Pike only asked us to bring back a tiny dose!
say:9:1120833005:1.source_cn: ——用完了，当然用完了！毕竟之前老爷只让我们找了那么一...

say:10:1120833006:1.text: Have you had enough rest? We need you to show us the way. I want to see what kind of treasure is worth the Dusk Eye...
say:10:1120833006:1.source_cn: 您休息好了，麻烦接着指路？阿德我还想看看埋在这里的珍宝...

say:0:1120834001:0.text: Right, this is it... The treasure is buried here!
say:0:1120834001:0.source_cn: 没错，就是这里……这就是珍宝的埋藏地！

say:1:1120834002:0.text: I've prepared digging tools for all of you. Let's begin.
say:1:1120834002:0.source_cn: 我已经给诸位准备好了挖掘工具，请吧。

say:2:1120834003:0.text: I didn't realize this job involved breaking a sweat...
say:2:1120834003:0.source_cn: 哎呀呀，没想到悬赏最后还要做苦力……

say:0:1120836001:0.text: My dress is filthy now... Is there really treasure here?
say:0:1120836001:0.source_cn: 漫漫的裙子都脏了……这里真的有珍宝吗？

say:1:1120836002:0.text: Lord Pike seems confident. Let's keep looking.
say:1:1120836002:0.source_cn: 看荒矛很自信的样子，再找找看吧。
say:1:1120836002:0.male: Lord Pike seems confident. Let's keep looking.
say:1:1120836002:0.female: Lord Pike seems confident. Let's keep looking.

say:0:1120837001:0.text: There's nothing here either, Lord Pike!

say:1:1120837002:0.text: No, it must be somewhere nearby. I'm certain!
say:1:1120837002:0.source_cn: 不，一定就在这附近！我绝不会记错！

say:3:1120839001:1.text: Superb, the venom worked perfectly. You're all too honest.
say:3:1120839001:1.source_cn: 很好、很好，毒液起效果然很快。你们是很有诚信的人，在考...

say:4:1120839002:1.text: So thanks for all your help thus far!

choice_prompt:5:1120839002.text: So thanks for all your help thus far!
choice_prompt:5:1120839002.source_cn: 这一路上，真是“辛苦”你们了！

say:6:1120839003:1.source_cn: 没错，铁锹上面涂着你们在第一道考验时搜集的诡蛛毒液……...

say:7:1120839005:1.text: This treasure was so hard to find. Why would I want to share it?
say:7:1120839005:1.source_cn: 我好不容易藏起来的珍宝，怎么能分享给别人呢，呵呵……

say:8:1120839006:1.text: Lord Pike... This treasure... You buried it here?
say:8:1120839006:1.source_cn: 老、老爷……这里的珍宝，是你藏起来的？

say:9:1120839007:1.source_cn: 没错，虽然深红高原埋有宝藏的传闻是我们散播出去的，可我...

say:10:1120839008:1.source_cn: 鲜血一样美丽深邃的宝石，石榴籽那么多的残阳之眼……但我...

say:12:1120839010:1.text: Rumors of treasure, workers, evacuation order....? No! What are you talking about?
say:12:1120839010:1.source_cn: 宝藏的传闻，监工，撤离命令……？不不不，你在说什么？

choice_prompt:13:1120839010.text: Rumors of treasure, workers, evacuation order....? No! What are you talking about?
choice_prompt:13:1120839010.source_cn: 宝藏的传闻，监工，撤离命令……？不不不，你在说什么？

say:14:1120839011:1.text: As you wish. It's been a long journey, and I'm tired.
say:14:1120839011:1.source_cn: 也好，这一路走来，我也累了。

narration:15:1120839012:1.text: Lord Pike takes off his disguise...

say:22:1120839015:1.source_cn: 呃……！怎么回事！为什么我的手动不了了……？！

say:27:1120839019:1.source_cn: 我、我怎么能在这时候失败？！我绝不会放过你们！

choice:13:0:1.male: Show us your true face, Pike.
choice:13:0:1.female: Show us your true face, Pike.

choice:5:0:1.female: You put venom on our tools?

say:29:1120839004:1.source_cn: 没错，铁锹上面涂着你们在第一道考验时搜集的诡蛛毒液……...

say:3:1120841001:1.text: And that chest we dug up... It's packed full of Dusk Eyes!
say:3:1120841001:1.source_cn: 刚才我们挖出来的，果然整整一箱子都是残阳之眼！

choice_prompt:6:1120841003.source_cn: 老爷小姐们，我有个请求。

say:7:1120841004:1.source_cn: 不……希望老爷小姐们，把这些宝石收好，一颗也不要给别人。

say:8:1120841005:1.source_cn: 什、什么？！满满没听错吧！你竟然连一颗也不想要？！

choice_prompt:11:1120841007.source_cn: 工头好心，让我老爹带回家去，给家里改善改善生活，但他不会藏拙……结果匪徒盯上了他。
